build_GRUTransformerModel: build a GRUTransformerModel that combines bidirectional GRU with transformer encoder for sequence modeling
build_GRUTransformerEncoder: build a GRUTransformerEncoder with bidirectional GRU layer to contextualize token embeddings before transformer layers
review_forward_embedding: review the GRUTransformerEncoder forward_embedding method that embeds tokens and passes them through a bidirectional GRU
configure_gru_transformer_base_architect: configure the gru_transformer base architecture with 512 embed dim, 6 encoder layers, and 8 attention heads
configure_gru_transformer_big: configure the gru_transformer_big architecture with 1024 embed dim, 16 attention heads, and 4096 FFN dim
